logistics.faktocraft.craft.batch_tip: Units the machine finishes per batch. Ingredients are delivered one batch at a time and the results are collected before the next batch starts.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.bind_hint: Pick an ingredient first to bind it here

logistics.faktocraft.craft.exact_tip: Exact ingredients: only the item drawn. Click to accept equivalent variants.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.flexible_tip: Flexible ingredients: accepts the variants the recipe itself allows. Click to demand the exact item.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.help.batch.te: How many units enter the machine at once. At x1 the pipe feeds continuously and collects the output as it is ready; use larger batches for recipes that need the full set, such as potions.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.help.bind.tex: Select an input or output, then click a machine slot to say where it goes in or comes out. Shift + click extends it to a range of slots. Right-click a slot to remove the binding; unbound entries use any slot.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.help.io.text: Click a box with an item in hand to set it. Right-click clears it. Scrolling changes the amount per craft (shift: 16 at a time).
logistics.faktocraft.craft.help.io.title: Inputs and outputs
logistics.faktocraft.craft.help.mode.tex: The colored badge on each input sets how it is delivered: gray once per unit, blue once per batch, orange kept stocked for fuel and catalysts, which never count towards the recipe.
Each recipe tells the pipe what the docked machine makes: which items go in, which come out and in which slots. A pipe holds many recipes; drag them in the list to reorder.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.help.share.te: With ÷ on, large requests are shared among every pipe that has the same recipe and this option on. At 1, this pipe only takes whole requests. Applies to the whole pipe.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.help.tag.text: Shift + click an input to switch between only that item and any item of the same tag (blue background). The equivalents take turns in the preview.
Seconds without progress in the machine before the request fails and the ingredients return to stock. Shift changes it by whole minutes. Applies to the whole pipe.
logistics.faktocraft.craft.io_set_hint: Click with an item to set it
logistics.faktocraft.craft.mode.maintain: Topped up in the machine to this amount; not part of the recipe and never taken back

logistics.faktocraft.craft.mode.per_unit: Delivered once for every unit produced

logistics.faktocraft.craft.tag_hint: Shift + click switches between item and tag
